_comment: A suite over PIPELINE RUNS, not over one stage.
Phase beta found the gap by predicting something the existing suite could not measure:
eval/compile-smoke.json drives orchestrator.run({ stage_id: 'compile' }), so it never
reaches refine or lint and cannot observe the depth plan, a skip, a partial degradation,
or the gate-feedback loop. A change to the pipeline's SHAPE was invisible to every suite
Each case pins what the provider returns PER STAGE, keyed by stage id. A stage with no
entry degrades -- that is how a case declares a partial outage without needing one. The
run therefore stays offline, deterministic and free, and what it measures is whether the
PIPELINE keeps its guarantees: that a degraded artifact is labelled and never laundered
by a later stage, that a shallow depth records why it was short, that a reflexive run
As with the compile suite: this is not a model evaluation. Nothing here is evidence
